name: OptiComm
summary: Independent FTTP access-network builder/operator for new residential estates, apartments and commercial developments; ASX-listed 2019, acquired by Uniti Group 2020 and kept as the market/wholesale brand. Took over operation of several former E-Wire estate networks in WA (2011) (OPTICOMM PTY LTD, ACN 117 414 776).

events.details: Acquired the rights to operate the former E-Wire HFC/FTTH network (e.g. Brighton estate, WA), upgrading the cable network to DOCSIS 3.0.

refs.label: iTnews: Opticomm takes over former E-Wire network
